Normal return:
• Must be requested within 7 days of delivery.
• A 10% restocking fee usually applies.
• Pickup or shipping fees may also apply.
Damaged or defective item:
• No restocking fee and no return shipping fees.
• The damaged item can be picked up and replaced during the same delivery visit.
• Repackaging is not required.
If the damage is reported within 7 days, photos may be reviewed to determine the next step.
So in short: damaged items avoid the fees and return conditions that apply to regular returns.
